It identifies clusters of coordinated civic activity, distinguishes routine engagement from patterns that precede security incidents, and feeds early warnings to law enforcement. He's proud of the architecture. Make the technical details specific — data pipelines, pattern detection models, alert thresholds. At least 3 verses.
